description: One variable-interest term loan per row on the 1000 / 22A / 100 profile, differing only in the length of the interest period. Create only, one write per row. The rows exist because the interest period is NOT a dropdown choice on this screen: SAP's Frequency list has no quarterly, half-yearly or annual entry, so a period is expressed as Frequency 'Monthly' plus a count of months.
authorised: Values supplied by the requester across three asks on 2026-08-19 (monthly, then half-yearly, then quarterly), each confirmed via AskUserQuestion before the live write. Carried over from TC-013/TC-015 and unchanged: partner 700000453, contract date = term start (SAP refuses a contract date after the start of term), reference interest rate RBI_REPO (chosen by the requester from the field's own live F4 list of 16 codes on 2026-08-19 - a data decision, not a discoverable default), General Valuation Class 'Short Term' (required on this profile with Variable interest just as with Fixed). The periodCount values are NOT a free choice: the Interest Frequency dropdown was read live on DS4/100 on 2026-08-19 and offers only At End of Term (1), On First Day of Month (5), On Last Day of Month (2), Monthly (3), Daily (4) and Manual Input (0) - no quarterly or half-yearly key exists. The adjacent unit dropdown offers only Days and Months and reads changeable=false, so with Monthly selected the unit is Months and the period is set by the count: 1 = monthly, 3 = quarterly, 6 = half-yearly.
